workflows.name: image-z-image-turbo
workflows.description: Z-Image Turbo 文生图（4–8 步蒸馏）；默认 bf16 底模，Qwen3-4B 文本编码器 + ae VAE，无负面提示（ConditioningZeroOut）。
workflows.label: Z-Image Turbo

workflows.name: video-h3-ref2va
workflows.description: MiniMax-H3 multi-reference on the VDN 8-step backend (Singularity + VDN stage-dmd-step-250; turbo adapter + TESpeed + Sage + SelfLift + SigmaRefiner, 9 NFE). Supports 1–6 images, 0–2 audio clips and 0–1 video (at least one media). Requires models/vdn/stage-dmd-step-250.
workflows.label: H3 多参（VDN）

workflows.name: video-h3-t2v
workflows.description: MiniMax-H3 text-to-video on the VDN 8-step backend (Singularity + VDN stage-dmd-step-250; turbo adapter + TESpeed + Sage + SelfLift + SigmaRefiner, 9 NFE). No image/audio/video input. Requires models/vdn/stage-dmd-step-250.
workflows.label: H3 文生视频（VDN）

workflows.name: video-h3-frames
workflows.description: MiniMax-H3 first/last-frame video on the VDN 8-step backend (VDN stage-dmd-step-250 + TESpeed + Sage + SelfLift + SigmaRefiner, 9 NFE). Requires 1–2 images: first, last, or both; task_type switches I2VA/L2VA/FL2VA.
workflows.label: H3 首尾帧（VDN）

workflows.name: video-h3-ref2va-novdn
workflows.description: MiniMax-H3 multi-reference on the original canvas chain (LightX2V 8-step LoRA + SolAttn/Sage + TESpeed + SelfLift + SigmaRefiner, 9 NFE; no VDN). Supports 1–6 images, 0–2 audio clips and 0–1 video (at least one media).
workflows.label: H3 多参（无VDN）

workflows.name: video-h3-t2v-novdn
workflows.description: MiniMax-H3 text-to-video on the original canvas chain (LightX2V 8-step LoRA + SolAttn/Sage + TESpeed + SelfLift + SigmaRefiner, 9 NFE; no VDN). No image/audio/video input.
workflows.label: H3 文生视频（无VDN）

workflows.name: video-h3-frames-novdn
workflows.description: MiniMax-H3 first/last-frame video on the original canvas chain (LightX2V 8-step LoRA + SolAttn/Sage + TESpeed + SelfLift + SigmaRefiner, 9 NFE; no VDN). Requires 1–2 images: first, last, or both; task_type switches I2VA/L2VA/FL2VA.
workflows.label: H3 首尾帧（无VDN）

workflows.name: video-seedvr2-upscale
workflows.description: SeedVR2 3B video upscale; target short edge, H.264, original audio preserved.
workflows.label: SeedVR2 视频超分

workflows.name: image-krea2-aesthetics
workflows.description: Krea2 Aesthetics fp8, qwen3vl CLIP + qwen image VAE, two-stage 7+10 step with 1.5x latent upscale. Clean base workflow; LoRAs can be injected via the LoRA card.

negative.default: low quality, blurry, deformed, watermark, text, mosaic, low resolution

workflows.label: Krea2 Aesthetics

workflows.name: image-seedvr2-upscale
workflows.label: SeedVR2 超分
workflows.description: SeedVR2 7B 图像超分；目标短边可调，输出保持宽高比。

workflows.name: image-esrgan-upscale
workflows.label: ESRGAN 快速放大
workflows.description: RealESRGAN / 4x 模型快速放大；按所选模型倍率输出。

parameters.label: 放大模型
parameters.description: 2x/4x 由模型决定；4x 输出尺寸较大。

workflows.name: image-qwen21
workflows.label: Qwen Image 2.1
workflows.description: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo. Text-to-image, multi-image edit, true-mask inpaint, outpaint; native RGBA via prompt template.

negative.default: artifacts, low quality, blurry, deformed, watermark

parameters.label: 参考图分辨率
parameters.description: 参考图缩放到约该边长；输出尺寸跟随第一张参考图

edit.label: 多图编辑
edit.description: 1–4 张参考图的指令编辑与融合

inpaint.label: 局部重绘
inpaint.description: 原图 + 二值蒙版，latent 蒙版约束，只改框内

negative.default: artifacts, low quality, blurry, deformed, watermark

outpaint.label: 扩图
outpaint.description: 原图 + 四边 padding，Qwen outpaint LoRA 补画新区域

negative.default: artifacts, low quality, blurry, deformed, watermark

t2i.label: 文生图
t2i.description: 纯文生图，不需要参考图；支持原生透明背景

negative.default: artifacts, low quality, blurry, deformed, watermark

workflows.name: image-moss-sft-8step
workflows.label: MOSS-Image 极速 8步
workflows.description: MOSS-Image SFT bf16 + Qwen3.5 9B + FLUX.2 VAE；内置 8-step DMD LoRA，默认 8 步 / cfg1 / euler simple，极速出图。

negative.default: worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact

workflows.name: image-moss-sft-50step
workflows.label: MOSS-Image 高质量 50步
workflows.description: MOSS-Image SFT bf16 高质量版；默认 50 步 / cfg3.5 / euler simple，SLG 跳过第 22 层，并内置 TE-Speed-MOSS 跳步加速（默认 te_predictor 2 / reuse 0.12 / error 0.06；实测 1.44×）。

negative.default: worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact

parameters.label: TE 跳步阈值
parameters.description: 调高更快，画面变化更大

parameters.label: TE 注意力后端
parameters.description: MOSS 上保持 default，其它更慢且改画面

workflows.name: video-h3-character-swap
